tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zhang blon sde dgu'i gtor bsngos bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru bai ḍūrya pra bha rā dza ya/

'dir tshe'i rig byed pa gang zhig zhang blon sde dgu'i gtor bsngo rgyun khyer bya bar 'dod na/ lcags sam ratna'i snod gang rung du/ 'bru sman gyi bshos bu zur gsum gcig la chung ba brgyad kyis bskor ba mtha' mtheb kyu dang bcas pa dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa'i mdun du/ sman raka dang mchod pa bshams/ skyabs sems bya/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpa' bo rta mgrin du gsal bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od 'phros mchod rdzas la// phog pas nyes skyon sbyangs te mchod pa dang*// sman raka gtor ma 'dod yon zag med rdzas// ye shes bdud rtsis stong khams gang bar gyur// oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda pañtsa a mṛta ma hā rakta ma hā ba liṃ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ lan gsum bya/ rang gi thugs 'od phyogs bcur spros pa yis// sman gyi srung ma zhang blon sde dgu dang*// sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// rang rang gnas nas spyan drangs mdun gyi mkhar// sprin bzhin 'khrigs nas dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs// oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda pū dza pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ mgron gyi ljags rnams rdo rje'i sbu gu can// gtor mar zug pas bcud drangs dgyes tshims gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā la yaksha badzra tsitta/ e ka tsā ti ma ma ru lu baṃ/ ke ta ke ta rā hu/ ḍā ki nī tsitta rakta/ yaksha tsitta ma hā rū tra/ badzra sā dhu sa ma ya/ raksha rakta rā dza/ dunti tsitta ka la tri shaṃ rbad bhyoḥ ging ka ra hab hab sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥhriṃ hriṃ/ ma hā ba liṃ ta a mṛta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ces gsum mam bdun nyer gcig skabs bstun brjod rjes/ hoḥ zhang blon 'bar ba rdo rje bdud 'dul dang*// sngags srung ral gcig khyab 'jug rā hu la/ mkha' 'gro lce spyang gnod sbyin shan pa dmar// rdor legs srin po dgra dur 'jigs byed che// shanti ro zan srog bdag hab se bcas// sprul pa yang sprul sman gyi srung ma'i tshogs// 'khor bcas sman raka gtor ma dgyes rol la// sman gyi bla ma'i bka' dang bstan pa srungs// rnal 'byor bdag gis gnas skabs mthar thug gi

/'gal rkyen kun sol tshe dpal 'byor pa spel// 'gro ba'i nyes gsum duḥkha gzhil ba la// lus ngag yid rdzas mthun nus phun tshogs shing*// bsam pa'i don kun 'bad med 'grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ yig brgya brjod/ badzra mu sa gshegs gsol/ bkra shis bsngo smon yang bya'o// zhes pa'ang gso ba rig pa'i gnas sogs la blo gros kyi lang tsho dar drags pa/ bla'i sman pa dkon mchog gzhan phan gyi nyer mkhor/ 'bri gung pa dkon mchog phrin las bzang pos sbyar ba dge/ //
